text:
Maya (Finance Ops): :mega: Heads up — new invoice validation rule going live next week (2026-03-30). All invoices > $2,500 now require a 3-way match (PO, goods/service receipt, invoice) before AP will schedule payment. This is to tighten controls after a supplier reconciliation gap.

Maya (Finance Ops): How it works: if you submit an invoice without a PO we will auto-create a hold and Procurement will reach out to get a PO or confirmation of non-PO approval. Non-PO exceptions are limited to one-off reimbursements and must include manager approval + Concur receipt.

Ravi (Procurement): Action for teams: please ensure vendor onboarding includes a default PO setup for recurring suppliers (SaaS, infra, contractors). If you run a pilot vendor without a PO, file a non-PO request in the procurement portal and tag procurement@redwood.com.

Omar (Eng Lead): Quick Q — what about cloud invoices that arrive late and exceed $2.5k for the month? We often get month-end adjustments.

Tess (Accounting): Omar 12sag: cloud provider invoices tied to an existing contract with a monthly commit are exempt from the manual 3-way match, but we still need the contract reference on the invoice. If it's an ad-hoc charge, use the non-PO exception route.

Omar (Eng Lead): OK thanks, we'll update our billing contacts.

Maya (Finance Ops): Timeline: rule enforced starting 2026-03-30. We'll run a one-week pilot on net-terms for the infra team starting 2026-03-23 to smooth the rollout. If you are processing >=$10k/month vendor spend in a team, we'll reach out to set up a brief onboarding call.

Invoice Bot: Automated: invoices submitted without PO after 2026-03-30 will be flagged "HOLD - 3WAY" and routed to Procurement. Please expect additional email workflow items.

Ravi (Procurement): Tip: to avoid delays add the PO number to the invoice PDF filename and email subject when sending to ap@redwood.com. Also please confirm service dates on the invoice to speed up receipt matching.

Maya (Finance Ops): We'll publish a short Confluence checklist and a one-pager cheat sheet. Link will be posted here tomorrow. Reach out to procurement@redwood.com for vendor-specific questions. :pray:
